title: NagmaDoc
description: A parsed, validated nagma composition: a melodic loop exactly one taal cycle (avartan) long. Produced by the core sargam text-grammar parser. Instrument-, tempo-, and key-independent.

taal.description: Taal identifier. MVP: 'teentaal' only, but the schema is taal-agnostic.

raag.description: Optional raag label for reference/library metadata. Not used by the compiler.

source_text.description: The original text-grammar the doc was parsed from, retained for round-tripping and editing.

matras.description: One entry per matra of the taal, in order. Length must equal the taal's matra count (16 for Teentaal).

notes.description: 1 to 4 note/sustain events subdividing this matra into equal slots (chaugun). This is the authored (vilambit) density; faster layas are derived by reduction. '-' sustains a slot for uneven rhythms.

kind.description: 'swar' = a struck note; 'sustain' ('-') = the previous note continues through this slot.

octave.description: mandra = lower (-12 semitones), madhya = middle, taar = upper (+12).
